environment.description: EC2 instance (c5.large) running Amazon Linux 2 in us-east-1, VPC subnet 10.0.1.0/24. The order processor binary is compiled with gcc -O2 (no stack protector flags relevant to this bug). Instance security group allows inbound TCP 8089 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer in front. Instance has public IP via Elastic IP. The service is directly reachable from the internet.
